purpose: Qualify a narrow JavaScript/TypeScript dynamic shell-execution rule without using an advisory target as the only answer key.

cases.basis: A variable command is passed to a shell-executing child_process API.
A concatenated command is passed to a shell-executing child_process API.
The binary and arguments are passed separately with shell execution disabled.
A constant shell command and an argument-vector spawn are explicit clean controls.

claim_boundary: These controls qualify rule behavior only. They do not establish attacker control, reachability, exploitability, real-world precision, or recall.
